# nemau_flavors (Data Source)

The organization's instance flavors.

Requires the `compute-flavors` organization feature; without it the API answers 403 and this data source fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the compute-flavors organization feature.
data "nemau_flavors" "all" {}

output "flavor_ids" {
  value = { for flavor in data.nemau_flavors.all.flavors : flavor.name => flavor.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Keep only the flavors whose name matches this value exactly.

### Read-Only

- `flavors` (Attributes List) The matching flavors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavors))

<a id="nestedatt--flavors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flavors`

Read-Only:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk, in GB.
- `id` (String) Flavor id, the value `flavor_id` takes.
- `name` (String) Flavor name.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory, in MB.
- `service_level` (String) Service level of instances of this flavor, such as `99.9%` or `best-effort`.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
